# Border Style

::: info 实现进度 55% · 进行中
Playground 已 `@source` 文档 markdown，这些类名可在本页示例里跑。未写入 `helpers.css`；SDK 里 schema 动态 class 仍依赖源码扫描。`m:` / `pc:` 只接到间距和宽高。
:::

线型。实线是默认。

```schema
type: page
body:
  - type: tpl
    className: border border-solid border-border p-sm rounded-md
    tpl: solid
  - type: tpl
    className: border border-dashed border-border p-sm rounded-md m-t-sm
    tpl: dashed
  - type: tpl
    className: border border-dotted border-border p-sm rounded-md m-t-sm
    tpl: dotted
```

## 类名

| Class | Properties |
| --- | --- |
| `border-solid` | `solid` |
| `border-dashed` | `dashed` |
| `border-dotted` | `dotted` |
| `border-none` | `none` |

响应式：`m:` / `pc:` 目前只接到间距和宽高辅助类。其它类请用 Tailwind 断点（`max-md:` / `md:`）。状态前缀见 [辅助类-状态样式](/style/state)。
